# On and off by default — the `scss` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#scss).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** an SCSS file, or `sass` in `package.json`.
- **Rules:** 51 — 0 on, 12 on with `preview = true`, 9 off in an opt-in preset, 30 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `scss/recommended` | yes, once the pack is installed | 12 | 12 error | SCSS correctness: unknown at-rules and functions' neighbours, duplicate definitions, placeholders, null tests |
| `scss/strict` | no — opt in | 20 | 20 error | scss/recommended plus Dart Sass's module-system migrations (no @import, no global functions, no slash division), unknown functions, naming patterns and a nesting limit |
| `scss/markers` | no — opt in | 1 | 1 error | TODO comments with a ticket (and a date when asked) |
